caption: The drawing depicts a single iron andiron, rendered in grayscale pencil on an off-white background. The primary object is shown in perspective, occupying the right half of the composition, with three curved legs supporting a vertical shaft that ends in a right-angle bend topped with an octagonal knob. In the upper left quadrant, there are two technical sketches of the object: a frontal view and a side view, both outlined with fine lines. Below these smaller sketches is a scale bar labeled in increments from 0 to 4 feet. The drawing is framed by a thin, hand-drawn rectangular border, and the background is uniformly light-colored with some yellowing and darker staining along the edges.
title: Andiron
